title: ULIPs (Unit Linked Insurance Plans)
intro: ULIPs combine life cover with market-linked investing; what matters most is total charges (allocation, admin, mortality, fund management), fund choice and track record, and how freely you can switch, all within a 5-year lock-in.
sources: Insurer product pages: HDFC Life, Axis Max Life, Bajaj Life, SBI Life, Tata AIA (Oct 2026)
Policybazaar ULIP plan pages and insurer fund listings (5 Oct 2026)

params.label: Premium allocation charge
params.tip: Share of each premium deducted before investing (Oct 2026).

params.label: Fund management charge (max)
params.tip: Highest yearly FMC on equity funds; IRDAI cap is 1.35% p.a. (Oct 2026).

params.label: Mortality charge
params.tip: Cost of life cover, deducted monthly from units; some plans return it at maturity (Oct 2026).

params.label: Policy admin charge
params.tip: Monthly policy administration charge as published (Oct 2026).

params.label: Fund options
params.tip: Number of funds you can pick in the self-managed option (Oct 2026).

params.label: Best equity fund, 5-yr return
params.tip: Best 5-yr annualised return among the insurer's equity ULIP funds on Policybazaar, 5 Oct 2026; check the fund is offered in this plan.

params.label: Free switches a year
params.tip: Free fund switches per policy year (Oct 2026); blank where switches are unlimited and free, see pros.

params.label: Loyalty / bonus additions
params.tip: Extra units added for staying invested, as published (Oct 2026).

items.name: HDFC Life Click 2 Invest Plus

v.mortality: Monthly, based on age and sum at risk
v.adminCharge: Nil in Growth option; 0.20-0.25% of annual premium per month in Loyalty options, capped at Rs500/month
v.loyalty: Loyalty option adds a Fund Value Enhancer and returns admin charges after year 25

pros: No premium allocation charge and no admin charge in the Growth option
Discovery Fund: 5y return 12.94% a year (as of 5 Oct 2026)
12 funds plus 4 free partial withdrawals a year after year 5
cons: Only 4 free switches a year (then Rs250, or Rs25 online)
FMC at the 1.35% cap on all funds except the discontinued policy fund
items.best: Low-cost online buyers who want a simple, self-managed ULIP

items.name: ICICI Pru Signature Online

v.mortality: Monthly; returned at maturity (not in Whole Life option)
v.adminCharge: Monthly; returned at maturity (rate not confirmed)
v.loyalty: Wealth Boosters every 5th year from year 10 (Policybazaar: 3.25% of average fund value)

pros: Mortality and admin charges returned at maturity
Opportunities Fund: 5y return 10.9% a year (as of 5 Oct 2026)
Unlimited free switches under the Fixed Portfolio strategy
cons: Wealth Booster rates differ between sources
Return of charges not available in the Whole Life option
items.best: Long-term investors who will hold to maturity to get charges back

items.name: Bajaj Life Goal Assure IV

v.adminCharge: 1.80% of annual premium in year 1, 3% in years 2-10, nil after; capped at Rs500/month (Ditto)
v.loyalty: Loyalty Additions at years 10, 15, 20 (1%, 1.5%, 2% of average fund value, Ditto) plus 2% Fund Booster at maturity

pros: 19 funds and 4 portfolio strategies
Unlimited free switches
Accelerator Mid-Cap Fund II: 5y return 9.65% a year (as of 5 Oct 2026)
Mortality charges returned at maturity
cons: Admin charge is high in years 1-10
Minimum premium Rs3,000 a month
items.best: Investors who want many fund choices and loyalty additions over 15-20 years

items.name: Axis Max Life Online Savings Plan Plus

v.mortality: Monthly, on sum at risk, by attained age
v.adminCharge: 0.30% of annual premium per month (0.25% if premium is Rs10 lakh or more), capped at Rs500/month
v.loyalty: 125%-150% of admin charges returned at maturity

pros: 28 funds, the widest choice here
Unlimited free switches and premium redirection
High Growth Fund: 5y return 18.21% a year (as of 5 Oct 2026)
Admin charges returned at maturity (150% for 15-year term)
cons: Monthly admin charge through the policy term
Plan offers High Growth Fund II; the 5-year figure is for the older High Growth Fund
items.best: Online buyers who want the most fund choice and free switching
items.news: Axis Max Life Online Savings Plan

items.name: SBI Life eWealth Plus
pros: No premium allocation charge
Midcap Fund: 5y return 13.07% a year (as of 5 Oct 2026)
Growth Strategy offers automatic asset allocation
Starts at Rs3,000 a month
cons: Only 2 free switches a year (Rs100 per extra switch)
No loyalty additions
Admin charge amount differs between sources
items.best: First-time ULIP buyers who want a low-cost online plan from a large insurer

items.name: Kotak e-Invest

v.loyalty: 3% of annual premium each year from year 6

pros: 12 free switches a year
Low flat admin charge of Rs400 a year
Frontline Equity Fund: 5y return 11.69% a year (as of 5 Oct 2026)
cons: Fund count differs between sources
Switches beyond 12 cost Rs250 each
items.best: Active investors who switch funds often and want a low flat admin fee

items.name: ABSL Wealth Max

v.loyalty: Guaranteed Additions of 0.25% of average fund value in years 6-10 and 0.60% from year 11

pros: Guaranteed Additions every year from year 6
Multiplier Fund: 5y return 15.77% a year (as of 5 Oct 2026)
cons: Charges not published on the pages checked
Multiplier Fund availability in this plan not confirmed
items.best: Long-horizon investors who value yearly guaranteed additions
items.news: Aditya Birla Sun Life Wealth Max

items.name: Edelweiss Life Wealth Ultima

v.pac: 6% in year 1, 4% in years 2-5, nil from year 6
v.adminCharge: 1.65% a year of annual premium in years 1-5, nil from year 6
v.loyalty: Guaranteed additions 0.25% and loyalty additions 0.15% of average fund value yearly from year 6; boosters 2.75% (years 10, 15) and 3.5% (year 20 onward)

pros: Three layers of additions: guaranteed, loyalty and booster
Unlimited free switches (minimum Rs5,000 per switch)
Equity Mid Cap Fund: 5y return 12.13% a year (as of 5 Oct 2026)
cons: Allocation charge of 4-6% in the first five years
Admin charge of 1.65% a year in years 1-5
Only 7 funds
items.best: Buyers who will stay 15-20 years to collect booster additions

items.name: Canara HSBC Invest 4G

v.mortality: Monthly; returned at maturity under the Life Option
v.loyalty: Loyalty Additions every 5th year (0.5% of average fund value) plus Wealth Boosters

pros: Mortality charges returned at maturity (Life Option)
Emerging Leaders Equity Fund: 5y return 14.49% a year (as of 5 Oct 2026)
4 portfolio management options including Return Protector
cons: Only 7 funds
Charges not published on the pages checked
Minimum premium Rs5,000 a month
items.best: Investors who want ready-made portfolio strategies and charge refunds

items.name: Bandhan Life iInvest

v.loyalty: Loyalty units in the last 5 years: 1.70% (5/7-year pay) or 1.80% (10-year/regular pay) of average fund value

pros: No premium allocation charge
Opportunity Fund: 5y return 13.8% a year (as of 5 Oct 2026)
Choice of Lifestyle or Self-Managed portfolio
cons: Switching from Self-Managed back to Lifestyle allowed once a year
FMC and admin charges not published on the pages checked
items.best: Online buyers who want a no-allocation-charge plan from a smaller insurer

items.name: PNB MetLife Met Smart Platinum

v.loyalty: Wealth Booster and Loyalty Bonus (rates not confirmed)

pros: Whole-life cover up to age 99
Mid Cap Fund: 5y return 17.96% a year (as of 5 Oct 2026)
Auto rebalancing option
cons: Only 6 funds
4 free switches a year, then Rs250 each
Premium allocation charge applies (rate not confirmed)
items.best: Investors wanting lifelong cover with a market-linked fund

items.name: Tata AIA Param Raksha Life Pro Plus

v.mortality: Monthly; refunded under the plan's refund feature
v.loyalty: Loyalty additions and Twin Loyalty Booster (rates not confirmed)

pros: Unlimited free fund switches
Whole Life Mid Cap Equity Fund: 5y return 15.16% a year (as of 5 Oct 2026)
Refund of mortality charges and loyalty boosters
cons: Has a premium allocation charge (refunded in some variants)
Detailed charges not published on the page checked
items.best: Buyers who want strong fund performance and charge refunds over a long term
